legacySimpleV1.caption: absent
legacySimpleV1.behavior: Read and render with the legacy three/four/three-slot composition. Never expand or rewrite it as canonical slots.

canonicalExperimentalV1.slotIds: Canonical p/f/e IDs in coordinate-document order.
canonicalExperimentalV1.caption: Optional string or null; absent and whitespace normalize to null in memory.
canonicalExperimentalV1.behavior: Read before attempting legacy-simple-v1 detection. Never mutate the row merely by reading.

canonicalV2.behavior: Read and render every occupied slot as centered cover. Never rewrite the row merely by reading.

canonicalV3.behavior: Read and render each occupied slot with its validated persisted placement.

editorial_collage.fourPhotoBehavior: Persist e1 through e4; render e5 as an intentional empty slot.

photoPlacement.default: Centered cover at rotation 0 for the selected photo and exact slot inner viewport.
photoPlacement.zoomRange: [1, max(6, coverZoom*4)] for the resolved photo and viewport
photoPlacement.zoomMeaning: effectiveScale / containScale. Zoom 1 displays the entire unrotated original image.
photoPlacement.pan: Free left/right/up/down movement; clamp only enough to retain 10% of the shorter viewport dimension as visible overlap.
photoPlacement.rotation: Rotation never changes the persisted zoom. Surface background may remain visible.
photoPlacement.slotBackground: #FFFDF8 surface token is painted before the photo and shared by editor, DOM preview, saved preview, and PNG export.
photoPlacement.previewExportParity: Editor, DOM preview, saved preview, and PNG export use the same pure placement geometry against the inner photo viewport after frame padding and footer.

rules.caption: Card-specific text; empty or whitespace normalizes to null and never updates photos.caption.
rules.decorations: Template metadata only; never persisted in layout_json.
